text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Pandora! What would you like for 
your birthday present?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for reaching out out of the blue! I 
looked around at all sorts of things, but 
nothing clicked no matter which shop I 
visited...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Just the two of us~, with plenty of time 
to relax and chat together â¡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-Tra... Training...? But Miss Pandora, 
you don't really like training that much, 
do you...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
If I'm with Kuu-chan-senpai, that's 
totally different♡ It's fun, and... I 
wanna become just like Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so don't bring anyone else along, 
okay? It's a birthday present, after all. 
...I want it to just be the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you under—...stood!? Then I'll think 
up some great special training for you! 
Like squats and—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh... nghhh... I'll... do my... 
beeeest...! Please guide me, 
Ku-chan-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! I'll do my best to make it the 
greatest present ever too!! J-Just like 
you, Senpai!
